title: PageSnap UI Unification · Consistency & Action Hierarchy
how: For each item: choose an option to observe the live mockup update beside the board. Answers are saved to plans/ui-unification/round.answers.json.

groups.label: Surface 1 · Floating Selection Dock
groups.how: Actions displayed directly above an element when clicked on any live webpage.

groups.label: Surface 2 · Component Studio Modal
groups.how: Layout, width, and action bar inside the deep component inspection sandbox.

groups.label: Surface 3 · Extension Popup Relationship
groups.how: Clarifying the boundary between Full Page extraction and In-Page component picking.

items.question: Should the on-page Floating Selection Dock include 'Copy Selection MD' for copying the chosen element as Markdown?
items.example: Clicking a pricing card and hitting 'Copy Selection MD' copies only that pricing card to Markdown instead of the whole page.
items.onScreen: The floating dock reveals or hides the '📝 Copy Selection MD' button beside 'Copy Component'.
items.why: The user explicitly pointed out that the floating dock represents the granular selected region (not the whole page), so having a 1-click Markdown copy for that specific card/section is valuable for note-takers and developers.

options.label: Include '📝 Copy Selection MD' on Floating Dock (Recommended)

ops.html: <button class="dock-btn" id="btn-dock-copy-md" style="display: inline-block;">📝 Copy Selection MD</button>

options.label: Omit Markdown copy from Dock (Keep only Studio, Component, and AI Prompt)

items.question: How should copy actions be named across the Floating Dock and Studio Modal to eliminate cognitive confusion?
items.where: Floating Dock and Studio Modal Action Buttons
items.example: Using 'Copy Component' everywhere prevents users from wondering whether 'Copy Code' generates something different.
items.onScreen: Button labels switch between unified standard names ('🎨 Copy Component') and legacy names ('🎨 Copy Code').
items.why: Previously, the dock called it 'Copy Code' while the Studio called it 'Copy Component', leading users to question whether they produced different outputs. Strictly unified naming eliminates ambiguity.

options.label: Unified clear names: '🎨 Copy Component' & '🤖 Copy AI Prompt' (Recommended)

ops.html: <button class="dock-btn primary" id="btn-studio-copy-ai">🤖 Copy AI Prompt</button>

items.question: Should the Component Studio Modal footer provide 'Copy Selection MD' in addition to 'Copy Component' and 'Copy AI Prompt'?
items.example: Inside the Studio Modal, a user who edits component text can click 'Copy Selection MD' to get their edited content in Markdown.
items.onScreen: The studio footer toggles the presence of the '📝 Copy Selection MD' button on the left group.
items.why: Providing 'Copy Selection MD' in the Studio allows users who just edited text in the sandbox to copy the modified content as Markdown.

options.label: Provide '📝 Copy Selection MD' in Studio Footer (Recommended)

ops.html: <button class="dock-btn" id="btn-studio-copy-md" style="display: inline-block;">📝 Copy Selection MD</button>

options.label: Keep Studio Footer minimal (Component & AI Prompt only)

items.question: How should the Popup delineate between Whole Page extraction and In-Page element inspection?
items.example: The popup header shows 'Full Page Mode' badge and a prominent 'Inspect Component' button to switch modes.
items.onScreen: The popup preview switches between explicit mode badges and a unified compact header.
items.why: The popup is optimized for 1-click whole-page conversion (Article/Full Page to Markdown & HTML Snapshot), while the in-page dock handles granular element selection. Clear labels prevent confusing the two workflows.

options.label: Clearly distinguish: Popup = 'Full Page Mode', Toolbar = '🎯 Inspect Component' (Recommended)
